New cost

Source: R/class_Cost.R
new_cost.Rd

Create a new cost object.

Usage

new_cost(name, layer, zone, weight, id = uuid::UUIDgenerate())

Arguments

name

character value with the name.

layer

new_layer() object used to store information for visualization.

zone

character name of zone to which this cost pertains. During optimization, planning units that are not allocated to this zone accrue a penalty based on these cost data. Note that zone must have a value that corresponds to one of the zone names associated with the new_project() to which this object belongs.

weight

numeric value denoting the relative importance of the cost.

id

character value with unique identifier. Defaults to a random identifier (uuid::UUIDgenerate()).

Value

A Cost object.

See also

Other functions for defining classes: Dataset, Project, new_categorical_legend(), new_continuous_legend(), new_feature(), new_layer(), new_lock(), new_project(), new_provenance(), new_solution(), new_solution_legend(), new_theme(), new_tile()

Examples

# simulate spatial data
sim_data <- simulate_spatial_data()

# create object
x <- new_cost(
  name = "cost",
  weight = 0.3,
  zone = "tourism",
  layer = new_layer(
    column = "feat_1",
    total = 500,
    dataset = create_dataset_from_sf(sim_data),
    tile = create_tile_from_sf(sim_data),
    legend = simulate_continuous_legend(),
    provenance = simulate_provenance(),
    details = "extra info"
  )
)

# preview object
print(x)
#> A <Cost> object.
